methods.name: Multinomial logit (run_multinom): Newton-Raphson fit, standard errors, z, p, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC
methods.reference: nnet::multinom(Hess = TRUE, reltol = 1e-16) re-solved by Newton's method on the analytic score and information
quantities: condition number and largest eigenvalue of the starting Hessian
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md: n = 400-500 coefficients 1e-8, SE and statistics 1e-6; n = 30 coefficients 1e-6, SE and statistics 1e-5 (relative); p-values also 1e-12 absolute; counts exact

methods.name: Ordered logit and probit with 5, 16 and 30 categories (run_ordered_model_with): polr's coefficients, cut points, standard errors and log-likelihood, category counts and null log-likelihood
methods.reference: MASS::polr(method = 'logistic' | 'probit', Hess = TRUE, control = list(reltol = 1e-14)); null log-likelihood sum_j n_j log(n_j / n)
quantities: fit unchanged when x is multiplied by 1e4 or 1e6 (coefficient divided by the scale)
methods.tolerance: the cases hold polr's own BFGS optimum, within 1.6e-9 (coefficients), 1.2e-7 (cut points) and 1.8e-6 (SEs) relative of the polished MLE (T2-WP10 Appendix B.5): coefficients and cut points Tol::iterative(1e-6), SEs Tol::iterative(1e-5), log-likelihood and null log-likelihood Tol::stat(n) (1e-5 for n = 30 and 96, 1e-6 for n = 180); counts exact
